entities.name: distal infraorbital nerve chronic deflation injury

relationships.subject: distal infraorbital nerve chronic deflation injury
relationships.evidence_quote: dIoN CCI and dIoN CDI groups showed elevated expression of calcitonin gene-related peptide and substance P in spinal trigeminal nucleus and/or ganglia.

relationships.subject: distal infraorbital nerve chronic deflation injury
relationships.evidence_quote: These groups also showed enhanced levels of dopamine, acetylcholine, 5-HT, and corticosterone and decreased concentration of GABA and noradrenaline in frontal and somatosensory cortices, brainstem and plasma.

key_findings: A new infraorbital nerve chronic deflation injury model reproduces pain and anxiodepressive phenotypes of the CCI model.
Both models elevate CGRP and substance P and lower GABA in cortices, brainstem and plasma.
